wheel.name: Wheel
wheel.summary: The pointer stops on one name.

meta.title: Spin the Wheel – Random Name Picker | Whozzie
meta.description: Enter names, spin the wheel, and let it stop on one. Fair, fast, and free for classrooms, teams, and parties.

wheel.heading: Spin the wheel
wheel.lede: Add names, spin, and see where the pointer stops.

how.title: How to use the wheel
how.step1: Type names one at a time, or paste a whole list, one per line or separated by commas. It holds up to 100 names.
how.step2: Press Spin. The name the pointer lands on is picked.
how.step3: Picking more than one? Take the winner off the list with the Remove button in the result, then spin again, so no one comes up twice.

fair.title: Is it fair?
fair.body: Every name gets an equal slice, so everyone has the same chance. The pick is drawn in your browser with cryptographic randomness (Web Crypto), the kind used for security, so no one can predict it.

uses.title: Good for
uses.body: Calling on students, choosing who presents first, drawing a giveaway winner, or deciding who buys coffee. Your list stays in this browser, so the same names are ready to <dice>roll the dice</dice> or <ladder>play the ladder game</ladder>.

wheel.needNames: Add at least one name to spin.

dice.name: Dice

meta.title: Roll the Dice – 3D Dice Roller | Whozzie
meta.description: Roll 3D dice for everyone on your list: the highest roll wins and ties roll again. Or just roll 1–6 dice and see the total. Free, no sign-up.

dice.heading: Roll the dice
dice.lede: Everyone gets a die. Roll them all and see who comes out on top.

how.title: How the dice pick
how.step1: Add 2–12 names. Each person gets a die in the same color as their name.
how.step2: Press Roll. Whoever rolls highest is picked. A tie for first? Just those people roll again.
how.step3: Everyone gets a place too. People tied further down share their place.

fair.title: Is it fair?
fair.body: Each die is thrown from a random spot, angle, and speed, all drawn from your browser's cryptographic randomness (Web Crypto). A physics engine tumbles it across the table, and the face that lands on top is the roll.

uses.title: Good for
uses.body: Deciding who goes first in a game, who takes the last slice, or who pays for snacks. For a turn order with no shared places, fill the <ladder>ladder game</ladder> with the Order results. Lost the dice for a board game? Switch to Just roll mode to throw up to six plain dice and see the total. More than 12 people? The <wheel>wheel</wheel> takes up to 100 names.

ladder.name: Ladder
ladder.summary: Follow the lines to match everyone with a result.

meta.title: Ladder Game Online (Amidakuji / Ghost Leg) | Whozzie
meta.description: Play the ladder game (Amidakuji) online. Enter names and results, then follow the lines to see who gets what.

ladder.heading: Ladder game
ladder.lede: Put names on top and results at the bottom, then follow the lines down. It's also called Amidakuji or ghost leg.

how.title: How to play
how.step1: Add 2–12 names, then choose the results: one winner, an order (1st, 2nd, …), or your own, like prizes or chores.
how.step2: Pick a name to follow its line down. It crosses every rung it meets and lands on one result.
how.step3: Press Reveal all to uncover the rest at once, or New ladder to start over.

fair.title: Is it fair?
fair.body: Every line ends at its own spot along the bottom, so everyone gets exactly one result. The results are shuffled and taped over, and the names are placed on the lines in random order, so everyone has the same chance at every result.

uses.title: Good for
uses.body: Handing out chores or prizes, assigning seats, setting a turn order, or deciding who pays for lunch. Just need one name? <wheel>Spin the wheel</wheel>.

ladder.hint: Pick a name to follow their line down.

results.hint: Results are shuffled and taped over until someone lands on them.
